name: Product Bundles
description: Create and manage product bundles with tiered discounts. Customers configure bundles on product pages and buy them with auto-applied discounts at checkout.

tables.name: bundles
tables.purpose: Master record for each merchant-defined bundle definition, its type, discount configuration, and enabled state.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal bundle id

columns.name: title
columns.purpose: merchant-facing bundle title

columns.name: bundle_type
columns.purpose: fixed or flexible bundle type

columns.name: discount_kind
columns.purpose: percentage, flat_amount, or bxgy

columns.name: required_selection_count
columns.purpose: for flexible bundles, number of items customer must pick; 0 for fixed

columns.name: shopify_product_external_id
columns.purpose: Shopify bundle product id returned from productBundleCreate

columns.name: enabled
columns.purpose: whether this bundle is active

tables.name: bundle_members
tables.purpose: Each product or variant slot that belongs to a bundle, with live availability state.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal member id

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the parent bundle

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: the Shopify product id this member references

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: set when the member is pinned to a specific variant

columns.name: available
columns.purpose: live availability state updated by products/update webhook

columns.name: position
columns.purpose: display order within the bundle

tables.name: bundle_discount_tiers
tables.purpose: The ordered discount tiers of a bundle — each tier specifies a minimum item count and the corresponding discount value.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal tier id

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the parent bundle

columns.name: min_item_count
columns.purpose: minimum number of items to qualify for this tier

columns.name: discount_value
columns.purpose: percentage as decimal string (e.g. 0.10 = 10%) when discount_kind is percentage

columns.name: discount_amount
columns.purpose: flat currency amount in minor units when discount_kind is flat_amount

columns.name: discount_currency
columns.purpose: currency code for flat_amount tiers

columns.name: free_item_count
columns.purpose: number of items given free when discount_kind is bxgy

columns.name: position
columns.purpose: ordering from smallest to largest qualifying count

tables.name: bundle_discount_external_refs
tables.purpose: Maps each bundle discount tier to its provisioned Shopify automatic discount, enabling targeted update and deactivation.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal ref id

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the parent bundle

columns.name: tier_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundle_discount_tiers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the specific tier this discount was provisioned for

columns.name: discount_external_id
columns.purpose: the Shopify automatic discount GID returned at provisioning

columns.name: discount_title
columns.purpose: the title used when provisioning, for storefront cart apply

columns.name: discount_kind
columns.purpose: basic or bxgy, mirrors bundle discount_kind at provisioning time

tables.name: bundle_purchase_counts
tables.purpose: Records each paid order that contained a bundle purchase for idempotent count tracking and admin display.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal record id

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the bundle that was purchased

columns.name: order_external_id
columns.purpose: the paid Shopify order id used for idempotency

admin.purpose: Return a paginated list of all bundles with their status and purchase counts for the admin dashboard.
Return the full definition of a single bundle including members, tiers, and purchase count for the edit form.
Create a new bundle definition with members, discount kind, and tiered discount rules.
Update any field of an existing bundle definition, re-provisioning Shopify discounts for changed tiers.
Enable or disable a bundle and activate or deactivate all associated Shopify automatic discounts.

widget.purpose: Return a bundle definition with live variant availability and pricing for a given product page.
Compute the live discounted total for a customer's current item selection against the matching discount tier.
Validate the customer's selection meets bundle requirements, then create a Shopify cart with the selected variants and the bundle's automatic discount applied.
